purpose: Apply one stocked 50.00 x 50.00-mm rectangular acrylic-foam PSA pad to the UI PCB by its own silkscreen datum, fold the exact EastRising ER-TFT035IPS-6 plus ER-TPC035-6 component-bearing FPC through the adhesive-free upper zone, pass only its narrow contact tail through one rounded PCB slot, mate it to one serviceable 50-contact ZIF on the UI PCB inner face, then place the panel by a second DISPLAY/FPC-UP silkscreen datum; neither the FPC nor ZIF carries panel load.

components.role: direct dual-contact 50-position ZIF for the exact 0.30-mm EastRising tail

manufacturing_route.baseline: one stocked 50 x 50-mm industrial PSA rectangle installed as a mechanical-assembly component
manufacturing_route.jlcpcb_documented_capability: manual secondary processing of selected mechanical assembly components is reviewable from a detailed PCBA remark or SOP
manufacturing_route.scope_boundary: JLCPCB documents arbitrary 3M double-sided-tape geometry only as an FPC stiffener fabrication feature, not as a custom PCBA display-bonding die-cut service
manufacturing_route.custom_pcba_die_cut_status: not publicly documented and the earlier support request remains unanswered
manufacturing_route.custom_contour_upgrade_rule: consider only if the same PCBA factory later confirms in writing that manufacture and installation are both included in the one order

mechanical_retention.panel_support: one stocked 50.00 x 50.00-mm rectangular acrylic-foam PSA pad applied to the flat component-free UI-PCB outer face at x=12.50...62.50 mm, y=44.46...94.46 mm; it supports 52.0% of the stiff panel plan while the complete folded-FPC zone above it remains adhesive-free
mechanical_retention.primary_retention: a single stocked rectangular industrial PSA pad applied to the UI PCB, never to the loose panel; its exact released thickness must exceed the measured folded-FPC maximum stack by at least 0.20 mm
mechanical_retention.secondary_retention: none in the assembled stack; PCB assembly datums and a removable placement fixture control alignment without becoming retained parts
mechanical_retention.flex_strain_relief: the tail leaves the panel toward board -Y, folds back once without twist into the adhesive-free pocket under the panel, and only the 25.50-mm contact tongue crosses the rounded 27.00 x 1.20-mm PCB slot before entering the inner-face ZIF. The 30.16 +/-0.50-mm source length, slot at y=23.00 mm and ZIF at y=25.00 mm preserve at least 5.00 mm of relaxed service slack after the actual bend/insertion path is proven. The pocket prevents component compression and the bonded panel prevents motion, so no sharp crease, routed-edge bearing, tensile load or peel load reaches the contacts or latch
mechanical_retention.service_rule: opening the sandwich exposes the ZIF latch; release the latch first, then warm and cut the rectangular PSA pad before lifting the panel, and install one fresh stocked rectangle on the PCB before reassembly

physical_realization.part_type: component-free region of the UI PCB outer face, not a separate purchased part
physical_realization.implementation: reserve the complete 56.54 x 84.96-mm configured panel projection as a flat soldermask-controlled landing area except for the single rounded 27.00 x 1.20-mm FPC tongue slot; the adhesive contact area contains no components, vias, test points, copper-height steps or silkscreen
physical_realization.load_role: supports the panel and transfers normal, touch and handling loads directly into the UI PCB

physical_realization.part_type: one stocked rectangular double-coated acrylic-foam display-bonding pad; no custom converter contour
physical_realization.implementation: apply one 50.00 x 50.00-mm rectangle to the PCB at x=12.50...62.50 mm, y=44.46...94.46 mm using its PSA silkscreen datum while the upper release liner remains fitted. It supports 2500 mm2 or about 52.0% of the exact panel plan, exceeding the roughly 40% partial-area bond visually inferred from the supplied ESP32-DIV sample photograph. The drawing uses a 1.00-mm envelope only to make the stack readable; H5 must select a traceable stocked industrial MPN whose exact thickness clears the measured current-lot folded-FPC maximum stack by at least 0.20 mm. No liquid glue, external converter order, adhesive on the FPC or separate upper strip
physical_realization.load_role: retains the stiff panel against lift and in-plane shear and supports more than half of its plan without a custom cut or separately positioned shoulders
physical_realization.material_candidate_not_yet_selected: 50 x 50 x 1-mm 3M VHB 4910 reseller pads prove that the stock format exists but are not yet an accepted production MPN or JLCPCB inventory item. The earlier 0.17-mm 3M 9495LE candidate is rejected unless measurement proves the required clearance
physical_realization.release_gate: freeze one exact traceable stocked 50 x 50-mm industrial pad MPN, live source, thickness, cleaning/pressure/dwell process and written one-prototype assembler acceptance before order. A custom contour is allowed only if the same PCBA factory confirms in writing that it will manufacture and install it inside the order; an external converter order is not allowed

physical_realization.part_type: two UI-PCB outer-face silkscreen datums, not retained parts
physical_realization.implementation: print a 0.15-mm DISPLAY placement outline 0.30 mm outside the exact 56.54 x 84.96-mm panel body plus an FPC-UP orientation mark; print a second 0.15-mm 50 x 50-mm PSA outline 0.25 mm outside the stock rectangle. Every silk line stays outside adhesive contact, so neither frame creates a thickness step under the bond
physical_realization.load_role: first locates the stock rectangle on the PCB with its liner fitted, then locates and orients the panel after the FPC tongue is passed and the upper liner is removed

physical_realization.part_type: adhesive-free folded-FPC upper zone, rounded PCB tongue slot and optional removable low-tack polyimide insertion guide
physical_realization.implementation: reserve a 47.90-mm-wide adhesive-free zone for the component-bearing FPC under the antenna-edge portion of the panel and one centered 27.00 x 1.20-mm rounded NPTH slot at board x=24.00...51.00 mm, y=23.00...24.20 mm; the 25.50 +/-0.15-mm tongue crosses with 0.75-mm nominal and 0.675-mm worst-case lateral clearance per side. Deburr the routed slot and use a removable low-tack polyimide insertion guide when mating; the folded FPC must not be compressed, bonded, twisted or allowed to bear on the routed edge. Dry fit must show at least 5.00 mm of relaxed path reserve before the PSA liner is removed
physical_realization.load_role: keeps the component-bearing flex unloaded and prevents panel motion from becoming tensile or peel load at the ZIF contacts

fpc_route_side_section.route: panel antenna-edge tail -> 180-degree fold through the adhesive-free upper zone under panel -> narrow contact tongue through rounded internal PCB slot -> flat inner-face run -> ZIF
fpc_route_side_section.stock_pad_release_rule: exact stock pad thickness >= measured folded FPC maximum stack + 0.20 mm
fpc_route_side_section.separate_upper_tape_reason: the stiff panel already has 2500 mm2 of primary bond area; observed ESP32-DIV construction suggests that a smaller partial-area bond is adequate, so a second strip or shoulder feature adds assembly work without a demonstrated need
fpc_route_side_section.slack_release_rule: with the received panel dry-fitted and the PSA upper liner still installed, the measured neutral-axis route from the panel exit to the connector contact stop must be <= 24.66 mm, leaving >= 5.00 mm against the 29.66-mm minimum source tail; the tongue must show a relaxed bow and must not pull the latch
fpc_route_side_section.bend_radius_gate: H5 must bind the 180-degree fold radius, folded stack height and pocket depth to the current-lot FPC construction before release; the drawing deliberately does not invent an unsupported radius or component height

mechanical_retention.structural_load_path: finger or handling load -> stiff panel body -> stocked 50 x 50-mm acrylic-foam PSA rectangle -> UI PCB -> sandwich stops and fasteners; never through the FPC or ZIF

esp32_div_v2_reference.panel_mount: raw 2.8-inch display body seated directly on the main PCB
esp32_div_v2_reference.in_plane_location: four empty 1.2-mm holes surround the display zone on a 49.10 x 68.25-mm rectangle; the official Gerber drill file marks them plated, but the copper flashes are only drill-size and the assembled-device photograph shows that they do not locate or retain the display
esp32_div_v2_reference.electrical_connection: 18-contact display FPC soldered directly to eighteen 0.4 x 4.5-mm SMD lands; no display ZIF
esp32_div_v2_reference.not_publicly_documented: the published Gerbers, PcbDoc, BOM, 3D model and assembled-device photograph do not identify a positive display retainer; the BOM contains no frame, fastener, foam or adhesive line, so a hidden PSA bond is plausible but unproven
esp32_div_v2_reference.leshy2_adoption_rule: use DIV only as evidence that a raw panel can occupy a direct PCB seat; Leshy2 explicitly defines the otherwise undocumented adhesive bond, assembly controls and a serviceable non-load-bearing ZIF

electrical.signal_contract: the UI PCB routes every required panel power, ground, i8080-8, recovery and touch net directly to the exact 50-contact connector; manufacturer NC and SDO contacts remain open
electrical.recovery_mode: deliberate strap change to ILI9488 4-wire serial; no QSPI claim

recovery_straps.primary_population: i8080-8: pin 34 and TE pin 39 are open; pin 38 CS is strapped low; RD is strapped high; IM2/IM1/IM0 = 0/1/1
recovery_straps.serial_recovery: service-only solder-jumper population links panel SDA pin 34 to S3 LCD_DB7/GPIO46 and moves CS pin 38 from ground to S3 LCD_DB6/GPIO42; the mode-select jumpers are repopulated to the manufacturer 4-wire-serial code
recovery_straps.safety: all recovery pads are on the opened inner face and cannot change mode during normal use

electrical.h2_rule: H2 places this connector on the UI PCB and routes the accepted panel map directly; no display adapter PCB or board-to-board display connector is populated.

orientation.panel_rule: mount the configured panel with its folded FPC toward the antenna edge (board -Y) so the tail never enters the LED, navigation or function-key zone
orientation.factory_orientation_check: before pressing the panel onto the stock PSA rectangle, the panel tail must exit toward the antenna edge, make one untwisted 180-degree fold through the adhesive-free upper zone and align its narrow tongue with the rounded slot and direct ZIF. The dry fit must preserve at least 5.00 mm of relaxed slack, panel pin 1 must meet connector pin 1, and no latch load is allowed; tail toward +Y, any twist, swapped 1/50 ends, FPC trapped under adhesive or a taut tongue is a stop-work assembly error
orientation.source_drawing_pin_order_native_front_vi: pin 50 at drawing left; pin 1 at drawing right
orientation.fold_axis: world X; one 180-degree fold changes the contact face but does not reverse left/right pin order
orientation.connector_footprint_rotation_rule: orient the exact H2/H6 footprint so connector pin 1 is at world x-min and pin 50 at world x-max; the dual-contact FH34SRJ accepts the contact face produced by the single fold, but it does not excuse a 1-to-50 pin-order reversal
orientation.display_memory_transform: rotate ILI9488 output by 180 degrees relative to its cable-down native orientation
orientation.touch_transform: rotate FT6236 coordinates by 180 degrees before UI hit-testing
orientation.tail_contract: manufacturer drawing controls the 30.16 +/-0.50-mm edge-to-tip length, 50-contact 0.50-mm pitch, 0.30-mm stiffener and native 50-left/1-right drawing order; Hirose controls the top-and-bottom-contact connector. H5 incoming inspection verifies lot conformity, one untwisted fold, 1-to-1 / 50-to-50 orientation, measured route <=24.66 mm, relaxed slack >=5.00 mm and insertion

evidence.finding: EastRising controls the tail exit at the short panel edge, 30.16 +/-0.50-mm edge-to-tip length, 50-contact 0.50-mm pitch, 25.50 +/-0.15-mm overall contact-tongue width, 0.30-mm stiffener and the drawing-view pin order 50-left/1-right, plus the complete CTP outline, 8080-8 strap and every LCD/touch/backlight contact.
Exact ER-TFT035IPS-6 is orderable at quantity one with the ER-TPC035-6 capacitive-touch option.

Hirose identifies the exact FH34SRJ-50S-0.5SH(50) as a 50-position, 0.5-mm-pitch, 1.0-mm-high horizontal ZIF with top-and-bottom contacts for 0.30-mm FPC. The dual-contact construction accepts the contact face after the one-fold route; the PCB footprint still must preserve pin 1 to pin 1 and pin 50 to pin 50.
FH34SRJ-50S-0.5SH(50) is exact HRS original-manufacturer C3169104, Extended SMT, Economic/Standard PCBA, MOQ 1 and verified live stock.

3M documents 9495LE as a 0.17-mm carrier-backed double-coated acrylic tape. That thickness is no longer the selected concept because the folded component-bearing FPC needs a measured clearance pocket; an exact thicker acrylic-foam grade remains an H5 selection gate.

The official ESP32-DIV v2 Gerbers expose eighteen direct-solder FPC lands and four empty 1.2-mm holes around the display zone. The holes do not retain the assembled display, and the public PCB, BOM, 3D model and photograph do not establish the actual retention method; a hidden PSA bond remains an inference, not a documented fact.

release_boundary: H1 freezes the exact panel, component-free UI-PCB display bed, mandatory board -Y / antenna-edge FPC direction, 27.00 x 1.20-mm rounded tongue slot at [24.00,23.00], one stock-format 50 x 50-mm PSA rectangle at [12.50,44.46], both silkscreen datums, direct C3169104 ZIF at [24.00,25.00], 50-contact electrical map, 1-to-1 / 50-to-50 orientation, one-fold/no-twist rule, >=5.00-mm relaxed-slack rule and non-load-bearing connector rule. H2 imports the exact footprint, rotation, slot and keep-outs and routes the display sheet directly on the UI PCB; before order H5 measures the current-lot folded stack, bend path and actual neutral-axis route <=24.66 mm, selects one exact traceable stocked rectangle at least 0.20 mm thicker, freezes its cleaning/pressure/dwell process and obtains written factory acceptance for placement and FPC insertion; H7/H8 inspect the one assembled prototype.
